main.description: P16 step 1 of com.etzhayyim.apps.mangaka.composeCharacterVrm. Reads the kind='character' vertex_mangaka row by rkey, fetches its reference-image blob from B2, base64-encodes it, and returns the merged ghost-hacker profile (gh:appearance / gh:background) alongside the image. ADR-2605082000 §2 — kind='mcp_tool'. SSoT: lg_mangaka.tools:tool_load_character_profile.

characterRkey.description: vertex_mangaka.rkey of the kind='character' row to load.

rwUrl.description: Override for RW_URL env (test path only).

referenceImageB64.description: Base64-encoded PNG of the character reference image (B2 blob).
